## Testing Mode
GREEN

test-exempt: static assets only / non-executable instruction files (behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5, exemption criterion 3). All affected files are reference documentation or config-reference files with no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: When this story is complete, INSTALL.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, and dso-config.reference.conf are updated to reference dso.workflow as the canonical config entry point

## Implementation Notes

### INSTALL.md
File: INSTALL.md

Changes required:
- Line 76: Replace `merge.strategy=pr` with `dso.workflow=ci-pr` in the description of what onboarding writes
- Line 80: Replace the onboarding instruction "set `merge.strategy=pr` in `.claude/dso-config.conf`" with "set `dso.workflow=ci-pr` in `.claude/dso-config.conf`"
- If any other references to `merge.strategy` or `enforcement.strategy` exist in INSTALL.md, update them to reference `dso.workflow` as the canonical key with the legacy keys noted as deprecated

### plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md
File: plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md

Changes required:
- Lines 656-658: Replace the merge strategy dispatch description to reference `dso.workflow=ci-pr` instead of `merge.strategy=pr`. The description should read: "`merge-to-main.sh` reads `dso.workflow` from `.claude/dso-config.conf` and dispatches to: `merge-to-main-direct.sh` (when `dso.workflow=local`) — runs the 7-phase pipeline below; `merge-to-main-pr.sh` (when `dso.workflow=ci-pr`) — creates a PR, queues auto-merge, polls CI + review threads"
- Add a brief note that `merge.strategy` is the legacy key, deprecated in favor of `dso.workflow`

### plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
File: plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md

Changes required:
- Line 43: Replace `merge.strategy=pr` with `dso.workflow=ci-pr` in the PR mode description
- Line 45: Replace the cross-reference "See `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` for `merge.strategy` and `enforcement.strategy` keys" with "See `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` for `dso.workflow` (the canonical key) and its deprecated predecessors `merge.strategy` / `enforcement.strategy`."

### plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf
File: plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf

Changes required:
- Line 29 currently shows `worktree.isolation_enabled=true`; if `merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, or `attribution.enabled` appear as active (non-commented) keys, they must be replaced with or preceded by `dso.workflow=local` (or `dso.workflow=ci-pr` as the example value) as the canonical key
- Add `dso.workflow=local` (or appropriate example value) as the primary documented key
- Mark legacy keys as `# deprecated — use dso.workflow instead. See CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md.`
- Follow the existing grammar of the file (unquoted key=value, # comment lines, blank lines)

### DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION
Gate fired: 2 (extends existing reference docs: INSTALL.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, dso-config.reference.conf)
Target files: INSTALL.md, plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md, plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no — N/A
Lines added to CLAUDE.md: 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD || echo "no unit test cmd configured — skip"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD || echo "no lint cmd configured — skip"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD || echo "no format_check cmd configured — skip"
- [ ] INSTALL.md references dso.workflow=ci-pr instead of merge.strategy=pr for PR mode setup
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -q 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' "$REPO/INSTALL.md" && ! grep -q 'merge\.strategy=pr' "$REPO/INSTALL.md"
- [ ] WORKTREE-GUIDE.md references dso.workflow as the dispatch key for merge-to-main.sh
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -q 'dso.workflow' "$REPO/plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md" && grep -q 'dso.workflow=ci-pr' "$REPO/plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md"
- [ ] CI-INTEGRATION.md references dso.workflow=ci-pr instead of merge.strategy=pr
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -q 'dso.workflow' "$REPO/plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md" && ! grep -q 'merge\.strategy=pr' "$REPO/plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md"
- [ ] dso-config.reference.conf includes dso.workflow as a primary (non-commented) key
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -q '^dso\.workflow=' "$REPO/plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf"
- [ ] Legacy keys in dso-config.reference.conf are commented out or marked as deprecated
  Verify: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ! grep -qE '^(merge\.strategy|enforcement\.strategy|worktree\.isolation_enabled|attribution\.enabled)=' "$REPO/plugins/dso/config/dso-config.reference.conf"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update INSTALL.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, and dso-config.reference.conf for dso.workflow
